title: Parameter compression in the flux landscape
summary: We present a data-driven investigation of the exhaustive ensemble of no-scale type IIB flux vacua constructed in \cite{Chauhan:2025rdj}. Using a combination of linear and non-linear dimensionality-reduction techniques, we analyse both flux and moduli spaces and demonstrate that the effective dimensionality of the underlying 12-dimensional flux space is substantially reduced. A central component of our study is a physics-informed autoencoder, which provides a non-linear compression of the flux and moduli data into a low-dimensional latent space.
